processing.simplification: deterministic vertex clustering per named structure
processing.registration: No individual transform or recentering; one identical affine transform for every structure.

anchors.method: Derived from named rib, costal-cartilage, sternum, clavicle, pectoralis-major and skin geometry before optimization; surface points use model-space ray projection.
